== Versions of 8 November 2026 ==
=== Build notes ===
* [[Fleet Security Protocols]] now shows the first-copy sheet text of 4 September 2009 ("each character … (those characters may be forfeited …)"); [[Fleet Security Protocols (Errata)]] shows the revised Block 6.1 sheet text (by 20 April 2010, "each of your characters … (they may be forfeited …)"). This undoes a 2026-11-08 edit that had put the later text on this page.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* A third text exists, unverified: a whole-card rewrite ("Once per turn, may deploy a non-unique starship (or vehicle) site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle where you have a starship or vehicle, characters at related starship (or vehicle) sites cumulatively add 2 to your total power and may be forfeited to reduce battle damage or attrition. When a starship (or vehicle) site leaves table, place it and all cards there in owner's Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)"). It is in the PC Legacy card data (swccg-card-json, undated) and GEMP used it until r13 (billbisco/swccg-gemp PR #732). The PC website card list also showed it in its 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11 captures ([https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html Internet Archive]). No dated PC errata announcement, sheet or Master List carries it, so it is not treated as a published version and is not on the article. Under investigation in the swccg-guild/work#227 context; Bill to rule whether it was real PC errata.
